admin-shell.filter.archived.active.description: Archive filter option on the roster: records that are not archived. The default.

admin-shell.filter.archived.all.description: Archive filter option on the roster: archived or not.

admin-shell.filter.archived.only.description: Archive filter option on the roster: archived records only.

admin-shell.filter.checkin.any.description: Presence filter option on the roster: checked in or not.

admin-shell.filter.checkin.no.description: Presence filter option on the roster: not checked in yet.

admin-shell.filter.checkin.yes.description: Presence filter option on the roster: checked in.

admin-shell.filter.role.all.description: Role filter option on the roster and the lookup: everyone.

admin-shell.filter.role.participant.description: Role filter option on the roster and the lookup: participants only. The default.

admin-shell.filter.role.volunteer.description: Role filter option on the roster and the lookup: volunteers only.

admin-shell.home.empty.defaultMessage: No permissions assigned. Contact whoever administers the system.
admin-shell.home.empty.description: Shown on the arrival screen to an administrator who holds no scope, so no section is listed.

admin-shell.home.title.description: Heading of the admin arrival screen.

admin-shell.logout.description: Sign-out button at the foot of the rail.

admin-shell.menu.close.description: Accessible name of the rail's menu button while the drawer is open. Pair of admin-shell.menu.open.

admin-shell.menu.open.description: Accessible name of the rail's menu button while the drawer is closed, on narrow screens. Names what the tap does.

admin-shell.nav.admins.description: Section name: managing administrator accounts. Planned.

admin-shell.nav.attendees.description: Section name: the attendee roster and editor.

admin-shell.nav.import.description: Section name: attendee import. Planned. An imperative, like a menu command.

admin-shell.nav.label.description: Accessible name of the rail's navigation landmark.

admin-shell.nav.lookup.description: Section name: the volunteer quick lookup, used at the door to find somebody by name.

admin-shell.nav.metrics.description: Section name: the live operations dashboard.

admin-shell.nav.pass.description: Section name: when the welcome line on the attendee's pass changes text.

admin-shell.nav.redemptions.description: Section name: redemptions of t-shirts (participants' and volunteers'), meals, drinks and lunch.

admin-shell.nav.soon.description: Tag beside a section that is planned but not built yet, on the rail and the arrival screen. Lowercase: it trails the section's name.

admin-shell.nav.survey.description: Section name: the experience questionnaire's state, override and answer downloads.

admin-shell.nav.tshirts.description: Section name: the T-shirt desk, where a purchased T-shirt is looked up and handed over.

admin-shell.nav.volunteers.description: Section name: each volunteer's access (retiradas, gerador de números, link do admin) and team, with the history of changes.

admin-shell.pager.backToFirst.description: Button after admin-shell.pager.outOfRange that runs the same search from page one.

admin-shell.pager.label.description: Accessible name of the pager landmark under a result list.

admin-shell.pager.next.description: Pager button: the next page of results. Feminine, agreeing with página.

admin-shell.pager.outOfRange.defaultMessage: This page is out of range.
admin-shell.pager.outOfRange.description: Shown when the requested page is past the last one, for example after records were archived. Followed by admin-shell.pager.backToFirst.

admin-shell.pager.position.description: Where the pager is: {page} is the current page and {count} the number of pages.

admin-shell.pager.previous.description: Pager button: the previous page of results.

admin-shell.presence.description: Label of an attendee's check-in state: a column, a filter and a record field.

admin-shell.present.description: Marks an attendee who has checked in but holds no arrival number, which is the case for volunteers.

admin-shell.role.description: An attendee's role, on the role badge and in the role select. other is only a fallback.

admin-shell.scope.attendeesLimit.description: What the attendees:limit permission allows: setting how many participant tickets the attendees editor may issue, and whether reaching the cap refuses the ticket or only warns.

admin-shell.scope.attendeesRead.description: What the attendees:read permission allows. Returned by the admin identity endpoint; the scope key itself is fixed by the database.

admin-shell.scope.checkinWrite.description: What the checkin:write permission allows: confirming an arrival without the QR.

admin-shell.scope.passWrite.description: What the pass:write permission allows: rescheduling when the welcome line on every attendee's pass changes text.

admin-shell.scope.tshirtRedeem.description: What the tshirt:redeem permission allows: handing over a purchased T-shirt at the T-shirt desk. The record page shows the attendee's verification code.

admin-shell.scope.volunteersWrite.description: What the volunteers:write permission allows: changing which counters a volunteer may redeem at, whether they may draw the raffle, the admin link on their pass, and their team and role.

admin-shell.search.label.description: Label of the search box on the roster and the lookup.

admin-shell.search.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search box: every field the search matches.

admin-shell.search.submit.description: Button that runs the search and applies the filters.

admin-shell.skipLink.description: First link on every admin page, visible on keyboard focus. Jumps past the rail to the screen's content.

admin-shell.ticketCode.description: Label of an attendee's ticket code, on the record form and the lookup record.

admin-shell.title.attendee.description: Browser tab title of one attendee's record. Never names the attendee: a history entry stores the title, and this keeps the name off the operator's device.

admin-shell.title.attendeeNew.description: Browser tab title of the blank attendee form. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.attendees.description: Browser tab title of the attendee roster. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.home.description: Browser tab title of the admin arrival screen. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.lookup.description: Browser tab title of the volunteer lookup, for both the search and one attendee's record. Never names the attendee: a history entry stores the title.

admin-shell.title.metrics.description: Browser tab title of the live operations dashboard. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.pass.description: Browser tab title of the pass welcome schedule screen. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.redemptions.description: Browser tab title of the redemptions screen and of one attendee's redemption record. Never names the attendee. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.survey.description: Browser tab title of the questionnaire screen. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.tshirts.description: Browser tab title of the t-shirt desk, for both the search and one attendee's record. Never names the attendee: a history entry stores the title. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.volunteers.description: Browser tab title of the volunteer permissions screen and of one volunteer's record. Never names the volunteer. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-shell.title.whatsapp.description: Browser tab title of the WhatsApp sender. {appTitle} is the application's name.
